messages.content: I forgot my online password — how do I reset it?

response:
You can reset your online password by following these steps:

1. Go to our website ([www.atlasbank.com](http://www.atlasbank.com)) and click on "Forgot Password" at the login page.
2. Enter your account number or username, and then click "Next".
3. Answer your security questions correctly to verify your identity.
4. Create a new password that meets our password requirements (at least 8 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters).
5. Confirm your new password by re-entering it in the required field.

If you need further assistance or have any issues during this process, please don't hesitate to contact us.
